text:
maya: Small, slightly desperate poll — assembling an IKEA bookshelf at 1:30am. Need a 40–60 minute soundtrack: low-energy but not sleepy, rhythmic enough to keep momentum. Bonus: tracks that make an Allen key feel heroic. any recs? :sweat_smile:

tom: Love this. Two vibes: 'mechanic' (steady beats) or 'bedtime rave' (slow BPM but punchy). My go-to: Boards of Canada 'Dayvan Cowboy' -> mellow but forward.

ben: For actual focus + tiny triumphs: start with Explosions in the Sky (shorter tracks), then slip into Sigur Rós for the 20-minute swell when things get weird.

lina: Also consider a lo-fi remix playlist — keeps you moving without stealing brain cycles. +1 for Boards of Canada.

tom: If you want punchier: throw in a couple of Prince instrumentals for the moments you triumphantly snap a dowel in. :muscle:

maya: haha love the dowel celebration idea. Anything with consistent tempo for the boring screw-in-late moments?

ben: 1) Khruangbin — tight grooves, transportive but relaxed. 2) Mild High Club for the one-handed-screw moments.

lina: Throw this short mini-set into the middle:

```
- Khruangbin — 'Maria También' (5:40)
- Khruangbin — 'People Everywhere (Still Alive)' (5:00)
- Mild High Club — 'Homage' (4:30)
```

maya: perfect. Can someone paste a single 45–50 minute Spotify link? lazy mode engaged. :pray:

spotify-bot: Suggested playlist: "Ikea Assembly Mixtape — Focus & Small Victories" (curated) — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0exampleLink12345

tom: bookmarked that link and added Prince instrumentals at 29:00 mark.

ben: Pro tip: set phone to Do Not Disturb and enable a 10-minute stretch alarm — mandatory celebratory stretch when top shelf is in.

maya: done. playlist queued, alarms set, allen key renamed to 'Excalikey' in my keyboard shortcuts. will report back. :crossed_fingers:

lina: report or it didn't happen. :mag: :joy:

maya: update in 45: assembled, one extra screw found in the carpet, Excalikey performed heroically. playlist = chef's kiss. thanks y'all. :tada:
